resources.string: Trial is OFF. Enable it in settings on both PC and phone.
Detection is not yet verified in this environment.

Connect over Wi-Fi or the existing paired Tailscale route. This screen checks every 15 seconds while open. With a status widget added and this feature ON, Android also schedules a best-effort 15-minute background check; Doze may defer it. PC observation starts with new turns after the collector starts. Only running, turn completed and interrupted are detected. Approval/input waits and task failure are not inferred. Turn completion is not project completion. Disconnection is separate from last known task state. No quota API calls are made. Existing history sync stays Wi-Fi-only.
Connection not confirmed. Check Tailscale on both devices, the running PC widget, firewall and enabled status trial.
